item.text:
=== BEGIN ARTIFACT TOPOLOGY.md ===
## Declarations

## story foundation
summary:      Establish the Go module and command scaffold.
type:         foundational
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   ARCHITECTURE.md
stack:        go.md, common.md
provides:     ./cmd/dupfind
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Create the Go 1.22 module and the ./cmd/dupfind main package. Keep application code within the module and use only the standard library.

## story command_interface
summary:      Parse command options and validate directory arguments.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-Command-Interface.md
covers:       COMMAND-001, COMMAND-002
accepts:      st-007
stack:        go.md, common.md
depends:      foundation
provides:     dupfind command interface
consumes:     ./cmd/dupfind
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Implement the CLI options, argument validation, directory validation, and documented failure exit codes and output channels.

## story duplicate_discovery
summary:      Find duplicate regular files recursively.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-Duplicate-Discovery.md
covers:       DISCOVERY-001
accepts:      st-004, st-005, st-008
stack:        go.md, common.md
depends:      command_interface
provides:     duplicate groups
consumes:     dupfind command interface
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Implement recursive file discovery, size-first hashing, digest grouping, and safe read-only handling for files and symbolic links.

## story listing_output
summary:      Emit ordered duplicate groups as CSV.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-Listing-Output.md
covers:       DISCOVERY-002
accepts:      st-004
stack:        go.md, common.md
depends:      duplicate_discovery
provides:     CSV duplicate listing
consumes:     duplicate groups
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Implement deterministic listing output with the required CSV fields, group order, numbering, and path order.

## story summary_output
summary:      Emit duplicate summary totals as CSV.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-Summary-Output.md
covers:       DISCOVERY-003
accepts:      st-006
stack:        go.md, common.md
depends:      duplicate_discovery
provides:     CSV duplicate summary
consumes:     duplicate groups
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Implement summary output for duplicate group count, duplicate file count, and reclaimable bytes, respecting the selected minimum size.

## story verification
summary:      Provide and run the project verification suite.
type:         service
kind:         test harness
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-Verification.md
covers:       VERIFY-001
accepts:      st-001, st-002, st-003
context:      sources/run.sh
stack:        go.md, common.md
depends:      command_interface, duplicate_discovery, listing_output, summary_output
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Provide bin/test.sh to run go vet ./... and go test ./... successfully. As the terminal story, run the supplied full grader and require its exit status to be zero.
=== END ARTIFACT ===
